title: Nitrogen-triggered amorphization enables high-performance solid-state electrolytes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,241-252
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05943G, Paper
Bolong Hong, Lei Gao, Bingkai Zhang, Pengfei Nan, Ruishan Zhang, Yuhang Li, Zhihao Lei, Ming Liu, Jing Wu, Longbang Di, Haijin Ni, Songbai Han, Jinlong Zhu
The amorphization ability of solid-state electrolytes was investigated, and a universal nitrogen-driven strategy was proposed to create a family of high-performance amorphous N–Cl based solid-state electrolytes.
